Danapur-Bihta elevated road gets forest clearance

The 20-km Danapur-Bihta elevated road has received the final statutory clearance with the forest department's nod for diversion of a small patch of roadside plantation.

The road will connect west Patna directly to the Bihta airport and the industrial park, cutting travel time from over an hour to about 25 minutes.

The road construction department said compensatory afforestation over double the diverted area has already been funded.

Officials expect the project, estimated at Rs 2,000 crore, to be completed in three years from the appointed date.

Commuters and industry bodies have long demanded the corridor, calling the existing two-lane road accident-prone and congested.
